mutants.description: fault_cause's capture gate takes the gate-driver enable En as 'running' instead of the supervisor's run_active, so a hard fault in S_RUN is never logged
mutants.reason: En is cleared combinationally by OTP, UVLO, latch_state and latch_assert on the same clock they rise, so when a hard fault stops the converter in S_RUN, convertor_running is already low and the cause bit and fault_time are never captured. An SPI read of the fault register after an OTP or UVLO shutdown from regulation returns 0 for that cause.

mutants.description: fault_arbiter's run window is qualified on the gate-driver enable En instead of run_active, so soft-start samples go into the RUN window
mutants.reason: En is also high in S_SS, and the run branch comes first. So during soft start every valley sample goes into the 16-cycle RUN window, the SS window never counts, and window_trip_SS never asserts: sustained overcurrent during the ramp no longer sends the supervisor to S_HICCUP, and FCOUNT_SS reads 0 over SPI.

mutants.description: OTP debouncer copied from the enable-switch instance above it: symmetric 20 ms qualification instead of the fault-flag default of 1 ms assert and 200 us release
mutants.reason: An over-temperature assertion must now last 20 ms instead of 1 ms before En drops and Red_LED2 lights, so an OTP_trig pulse of 1 to 20 ms no longer shuts the converter down. A cleared OTP also takes 20 ms instead of 200 us before the converter may restart.

mutants.description: The FAULT_FLAGS register's current-protection bit reports the RUN overcurrent window trip instead of the live synchronised CP comparator
mutants.reason: Reading FAULT_FLAGS over SPI while CP_trig is high in S_OFF, S_SS or S_HICCUP, or in S_RUN before the window reaches trip_run, returns the CP bit as 0 instead of 1, unlike the OTP and UVLO bits next to it, which show the live flags.

mutants.description: The switch-press edge detector's delayed copy is taken from the undebounced synchronised switch instead of the debounced one it is compared with
mutants.reason: The debounced switch rises only after the synchronised level has been high for 20 ms, so the delayed copy is already 1 and en_switch_rise never fires. After the host clears spi_enable, turning the physical switch off and on again no longer re-enables the converter, and En stays low.

mutants.description: strike_counter's clean-run streak is gated on the qualified PGOOD instead of run_active, so 'clean running' is taken to mean 'rail in regulation'
mutants.reason: The streak cannot start until PGOOD has qualified, about 9 ms into S_RUN, and a dip on PGOOD_comp breaks it while still in S_RUN. Strikes therefore clear later than clean_run_target cycles after reaching S_RUN, or never on a rail that dips. This shows in Red_LED1 blinking longer, in the STRIKE_LEVEL read, and in the next hiccup's back-off and the latch trip.
